segments.text: Want to run LLMs locally but don't know what your hardware can handle? LM fit right sizes models to your system.
Terminal tool detects RAM, CPU, GPU, VRAM and compares against a database of 33 popular models. Tells you exactly which ones will run. Run LLM fit.
Interactive TUI shows system specs scrollable model table sorted by compatibility. Hardware detection reads RAM via CIS info. count CPU cores.
